title: The whole component walk stops on a wording it did not expect
goal: The scripted walk that covers the whole component path from drawing to copies stops two thirds of the way through, because a control it checks now says more than the walk was told to expect. Nothing in the app looks wrong; the walk simply cannot finish, so the longest component test we have is not running to the end. Work out which side is right and put them back in step.
notes:
Reproduced on main at dcd83620 (with the version-row change stashed, so it predates it):

  $ Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/component-whole-path-walk.json
  "error" : "step 173 (expect): the control called \"Apply to Other Versions\" reads \"Shadow, there is something to carry\", not \"there is something to carry\"",
  "status" : "failed",
  "steps" : 172

The control gained a leading section name in its detail ("Shadow, ..."). Either the expect string wants the section prefix or the detail should not carry it; the same expect appears more than once in that walk.
acceptance: Whichever side changed, the walk still checks that the carry-across control says whether there is something to carry
